title: feat: add ElevenLabs stem separation
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `elevenlabs/stem-separation`: paid-only, multiplier **1**, no aliases, direct ElevenLabs. No equivalent fallback on fal, Replicate, Azure, or Fireworks.
- Adds a thin native `POST /alpha/audio/stem-separation`: multipart `model`, `file` (≤50 MB), `stem_variation_id` (`two_stems_v1` or default `six_stems_v1`). Forwards [ElevenLabs' upstream endpoint](https://elevenlabs.io/docs/api-reference/music/separate-stems) and returns its ZIP of 44.1 kHz/128 kbps MP3s unchanged; non-ZIP upstream responses return `502` so they are never billed or cached as audio.
- Bills the decoded input duration at **$0.15/min (two)** or **$0.30/min (six)**. ElevenLabs sends no usage headers.
- No per-stem uploads, second response format, or output unzip/duration cross-check.

Local E2E (real `GenerationCoordinator`, media worker/R2, local D1, Tinybird ingest captured locally), reconciled against ElevenLabs workspace usage:

| Case | Result |
|---|---|
| 60s six-stem: client aborts at 2s, identical request rejoins, third request after completion | 1 upstream call, rejoin gets the ZIP, third is an R2 `HIT` in 14ms, byte-identical; 1 debit (0.30), 1 billed event |
| CBR MP3, VBR MP3 (Xing), WAV, FLAC, Ogg/Opus — 10.3s | billed 10.3s exactly |
| VBR MP3 without Xing / AAC `.m4a` | billed 10.318s / 10.323s (+18/+23 ms encoder padding/priming) |
| 361.7s MP3 (two stems) | billed 361.7s |
| All 9 upstream calls | ElevenLabs: 493.854s, $1.384635 · Pollinations: 493.842s, $1.384604 |

Tests: full gen suite, enter pricing snapshot, TypeScript, Biome; regression test for a `200 audio/mpeg` upstream response (502, no billing, no cache).

gist.headline: A song, neatly unbundled
gist.blurb: Send in a song; get its separate parts back in a ZIP. Polli is already deciding which track to listen to first.
gist.summary: Added paid-only ElevenLabs stem separation at POST /alpha/audio/stem-separation, accepting audio files up to 50 MB and returning a ZIP of either two MP3 stems at $0.15/min or six at $0.30/min.
gist.impact: Developers can split uploaded audio into two stems or the default six stems through one API call, with billing based on the input audio’s duration.
gist.visual_concept: Depict one music waveform branching into six tidy audio tracks that flow into a ZIP parcel. Polli wears tiny headphones and listens to one track beside a glowing retro terminal; lime-green code-plants and flowers make the scene feel like a little sound garden.
